title: Beta launch retrospective
text:
Look back at the Nov 2 Westbrook launch. Facilitator: Wop testwell.

Attendees: Maya Chen, Daniel Ortiz, Priya Raman, Sam Okafor, Wop testwell, Tomas Rivera.

Topics:
- Launch numbers: sign-ups, groups created, first sessions
- What went well, what went wrong (API speed, notifications, store review)
- Top student requests (library room booking?)
- What to change before Lakeside College in January

Notes go in a new page in Pairly HQ (Notion).
